sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate is semantically faithful and deterministic validation is valid. It preserves optional component existence, validates enclosedByPlatedBossing on the component owners, and conditionally requires the detached-strut relationship and all three contract-declared evidence paths when detachedStrut is true, while allowing the false branch.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Do not require presence of side-propeller shafting or stern tubes: the universal enclosure rule does not imply sh:minCount 1 for hasSidePropellerShafting or hasSternTube. Also remove the invented mandatory design, strength, and hull-attachment evidence constraints: dependencyContract.evidenceTerms is empty, so "due consideration" must not be approximated as required evidence artifacts.
